meaning: Face clearance and off-hand follow the v003.3 validator rules, run on ShapeKit assemblies (v003.3 poses and clips, variant tiles). Weapon and hands must have 0 opaque pixels in the head's visor rect on every named pose and every clip frame; smears too. Off-hand is coordinate-only (same for every combo). Joint overlap and ground contact are checked on a covering set of combos including the heaviest. Piston-leg plant uses the kit thresholds (body within 3 px of ground_y-1, nothing below ground_y+1). Visor-eye pixels (#FFE65C) must stay at least 80% visible in the z-ordered composite on every pose and clip, and 80% clear of the chest silhouette on stance poses (idle, windup, strike, …). Defeat and knockout are exempt from the chest-clear test because the head rests on the chest, but eyes must still be visible. The same rule applies to mace and hammer when those weapons exist. The kit folder is not written.
